doc.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Draft status and the psychiatrist who spoke Yiddish
summary: He recalls being told in Yiddish by a psychiatrist he would not be drafted because of his eyesight.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: You were just young enough to not have to deal with World War Two and the military service issue, right?
Well I was actually told in Yiddish by the psychiatrist not to worry, I won’t have to go in, supposedly, because of my eyesight. I don’t know why he spoke to tell me that in Jewish, but . . .
In any language that was welcome news.
